name: GTSAM
summary: Georgia Tech factor-graph library for smoothing and mapping, with incremental solvers (iSAM2) and a full IMU preintegration factor set. Ships Python bindings and navigation examples combining IMU with GPS-style measurements.
why_it_matters: The default backbone for building a custom GNSS/INS or multi-sensor navigation estimator where you add or drop sensor factors as GNSS degrades.
hackathon_notes: pip install gtsam gives Python bindings; start from the ImuFactor examples and add a GNSS position factor. Noise model tuning is where time goes.

name: Ceres Solver
summary: Google's nonlinear least-squares and general optimization library with automatic differentiation and robust loss functions.
why_it_matters: Used as the solver under many VIO and GNSS/INS optimizers (VINS-Fusion, OB_GINS); good for writing your own sliding-window estimator.
hackathon_notes: Solid but you write the residuals yourself. Pair with an existing IMU preintegration residual (e.g. from OB_GINS) rather than deriving from scratch.

name: g2o
summary: General framework for graph optimization, widely used for pose-graph SLAM back ends.
why_it_matters: Lightweight pose-graph back end when you need loop closure or map alignment on top of an inertial front end.
hackathon_notes: Best for pose graphs; IMU factors are less turnkey than in GTSAM.

name: robot_localization
summary: ROS package with EKF and UKF state estimation nodes that fuse any number of odometry, IMU, pose and GNSS inputs, plus a navsat_transform node for GPS-to-map conversion.
why_it_matters: Fastest route to a working fused odometry on a ROS ground robot or drone; the usual baseline before writing a custom filter.
hackathon_notes: apt install on ROS 2; mostly YAML config. Common gotcha: frame conventions (REP-103/105) and double-counting velocities.

name: FilterPy
summary: Python library of Kalman filters (linear, extended, unscented, ensemble), smoothers, particle filtering helpers and related estimators.
why_it_matters: Quick prototyping of filters in notebooks before porting to embedded code.
hackathon_notes: pip install filterpy. Not Lie-group aware, so handle attitude error states manually or use navlie/manif for that.

name: Kalman and Bayesian Filters in Python (book)
summary: Free interactive book of Jupyter notebooks teaching Kalman, EKF, UKF and particle filters with an intuition-first approach.
why_it_matters: Fastest onboarding for team members new to estimation.
hackathon_notes: Run the notebooks locally or in Binder; chapters on UKF and EKF are enough for a hackathon.

name: sfwa UKF
summary: Templated C++ unscented Kalman filter library for state and parameter estimation, including square-root variants, aimed at embedded use.
why_it_matters: Option for an embedded UKF attitude/navigation filter with compile-time state definitions.
hackathon_notes: Heavy template code; worth it only if you specifically need a UKF on a microcontroller-class target.

name: ethzasl_msf (Multi Sensor Fusion)
summary: Modular EKF framework from ETH ASL for fusing IMU propagation with pose, position and other sensor updates, with delayed-measurement handling.
why_it_matters: Classic MAV state estimator that shows how to fuse delayed vision/GPS measurements into an IMU-driven filter.
hackathon_notes: ROS 1 era; building on modern distros takes effort. Read it for the design more than to run it.

name: MaRS (Modular and Robust Sensor-Fusion)
summary: Modular IMU-driven sensor-fusion framework from University of Klagenfurt designed so sensors can be added, removed or fail at runtime without reworking the core filter.
why_it_matters: Directly relevant to graceful degradation when GNSS or another aiding sensor drops out.
hackathon_notes: Core library builds standalone; ROS wrapper exists separately. Good fit for a sensor-dropout demo.

name: KF-GINS
summary: Wuhan University i2Nav reference implementation of loosely coupled GNSS/INS integration with an error-state EKF, with sample data and documentation.
why_it_matters: Clean, readable GNSS/INS baseline in the PSINS/Groves tradition; ideal to adapt for GNSS-outage experiments.
hackathon_notes: Builds with CMake and Eigen; includes demo dataset. Simulate outages by masking GNSS epochs and watch drift.

name: OB_GINS
summary: Optimization-based GNSS/INS integration from Wuhan University i2Nav, using IMU preintegration in a sliding-window factor graph solved with Ceres.
why_it_matters: Shows the optimization alternative to KF-GINS on the same problem, useful for comparing filter vs smoother under outages.
hackathon_notes: Same data formats as KF-GINS, so run both on one dataset for a side-by-side comparison.

name: IC-GVINS
summary: INS-centric GNSS-visual-inertial navigation system from i2Nav, where the precise INS drives the visual front end and GNSS is fused in a factor graph.
why_it_matters: Template for camera-aided INS that keeps working through GNSS denial.
hackathon_notes: ROS-based; heavier setup than KF-GINS. Use their datasets first.

name: LE-VINS
summary: INS-centric visual-inertial navigation with LiDAR depth enhancement for visual features, from i2Nav.
why_it_matters: Shows LiDAR-aided VIO in the same INS-centric architecture as IC-GVINS.
hackathon_notes: Needs camera+LiDAR+IMU data; research code.

name: NaveGo
summary: Open MATLAB/GNU Octave toolbox for simulating and processing integrated INS/GNSS navigation, including IMU error modelling and Allan variance analysis.
why_it_matters: Quick offline analysis and simulation of INS/GNSS without compiling anything.
hackathon_notes: Works in Octave if no MATLAB licence. Last push 2024, so treat as stable rather than evolving.

name: GICI-LIB
summary: GNSS/INS/Camera integrated navigation library supporting a range of GNSS modes (SPP, RTK, PPP and variants) tightly fused with inertial and visual data via factor graph optimization.
why_it_matters: One of the most complete open tightly coupled GNSS/INS/vision stacks; good for showing positioning robustness in degraded GNSS.
hackathon_notes: Large codebase; run on the provided dataset first. Config files are the main interface.

name: GLIO
summary: Tightly coupled GNSS/LiDAR/IMU integration (PolyU) for continuous, drift-free state estimation in urban canyons.
why_it_matters: Shows how raw GNSS measurements can be kept in the loop even when only a few satellites are visible.
hackathon_notes: ROS 1 research code; needs raw GNSS observables in the data.

name: GraphGNSSLib
summary: Open package for GNSS single point positioning and RTK using factor graph optimization instead of an EKF (PolyU).
why_it_matters: Useful base for GNSS factors that can be combined with inertial factors in a single graph.
hackathon_notes: ROS 1 + Ceres; uses RTKLIB internals for observation handling.

name: pyins
summary: Python package for modelling and analysing inertial navigation systems: strapdown integration, error models, Kalman-filter aiding and sensor simulation.
why_it_matters: Pure-Python INS/GNSS playground for quick outage and sensor-grade studies.
hackathon_notes: pip install python-ins (the PyPI name; import as pyins), pure Python with numba; docs on readthedocs. Good for scripted what-if plots (tactical vs MEMS IMU drift).

name: strapdown-rs
summary: Rust implementation of a strapdown inertial navigation system, aimed at simulation and research on INS behaviour.
why_it_matters: Lesser-known, actively developed Rust INS; memory-safe option for embedded or simulation pipelines.
hackathon_notes: cargo build; small and readable. Check the crate docs for current API.

name: PX4-ECL (archived)
summary: Former home of PX4's estimation and control library including the EKF2 navigation filter; archived after the code moved into PX4-Autopilot.
why_it_matters: Historical reference for a widely flown 24-state EKF; use the PX4-Autopilot tree for current code.
hackathon_notes: Read-only reference; current EKF2 lives under src/modules/ekf2 in PX4-Autopilot.

name: ESKF (je310)
summary: Error-state Kalman filter implementation following Sola's quaternion ESKF formulation.
why_it_matters: Compact code reference for Sola's equations when writing your own ESKF.
hackathon_notes: Small codebase, no recent updates; read alongside the Sola report.

name: ESKF ROS (EliaTarasov)
summary: ROS error-state Kalman filter derived from PX4/ecl that fuses IMU with GPS, magnetometer, vision pose and optical flow.
why_it_matters: PX4-style estimator outside the autopilot, easy to feed from a bag.
hackathon_notes: ROS 1, unmaintained since 2019.

name: imu_gps_localization
summary: Error-state Kalman filter fusing IMU and GPS for localization, small and readable.
why_it_matters: Minimal ESKF GNSS/IMU example good for a first hackathon filter.
hackathon_notes: Small ROS project; easy to strip ROS and port.

name: eskf-gps-imu-fusion
summary: ESKF fusing GPS and IMU for improved positioning, with documentation in Chinese.
why_it_matters: Another compact ESKF reference with a worked dataset.
hackathon_notes: Standalone CMake build; docs are in Chinese.

name: imu_x_fusion
summary: Loosely coupled IMU + GNSS / 6-DoF odometry fusion with multiple estimators side by side (ESKF, IEKF, UKF variants, MAP).
why_it_matters: Lets you compare filter variants on the same inputs with little code.
hackathon_notes: ROS package; swap estimator by config to compare behaviour.

name: gps_imu_fusion
summary: GPS/IMU fusion examples implemented with ESKF, EKF, UKF and other filters.
why_it_matters: Small comparison set of filter types for GNSS/IMU.
hackathon_notes: Inactive since 2022; use as reading material.

name: invariant-ekf (Hartley InEKF)
summary: C++ library implementing the invariant EKF for aided inertial navigation, including contact-aided legged-robot state estimation.
why_it_matters: Reference InEKF implementation; invariant filters behave better than standard EKF under large initial errors.
hackathon_notes: Last push 2019; still compiles with Eigen. Pairs with the Hartley 2019 paper.

name: DRIFT
summary: Symmetry-preserving (invariant) state estimation library from University of Michigan for legged, wheeled and other robots, with real-time ROS support.
why_it_matters: Maintained InEKF stack for proprioceptive dead reckoning when GNSS and vision are unavailable.
hackathon_notes: Has ROS examples; try on a wheeled robot bag for GNSS-free odometry.

name: iekf (contagon)
summary: Invariant Kalman filter implementation on SE(2) and SE(3).
why_it_matters: Small Python-side InEKF example for learning.
hackathon_notes: Small research repo; use for learning the algorithm.

name: gnss-ins-sim
summary: Aceinna's GNSS/INS simulator: generates trajectories and corrupted IMU/GNSS/magnetometer data from sensor error models and runs user algorithms on it.
why_it_matters: Generate controlled IMU data for outage and sensor-grade experiments without hardware.
hackathon_notes: Pure Python; define a motion profile CSV and sensor grade, then plug your filter in as an algorithm.

name: allan_variance_ros
summary: ROS tool (Oxford DRS) that computes Allan deviation plots from an IMU bag and outputs noise parameters in a Kalibr-compatible format.
why_it_matters: Needed to get realistic IMU noise values for any filter or VIO setup.
hackathon_notes: Record a few hours of static IMU data before the event; the analysis itself is quick.

name: imu_utils
summary: ROS package for analysing IMU performance with Allan variance to estimate noise and bias instability.
why_it_matters: Common alternative to allan_variance_ros in VIO workflows.
hackathon_notes: ROS 1, depends on Ceres; needs long static logs.

name: kalibr_allan (archived)
summary: MATLAB scripts producing IMU Allan standard deviation charts and Kalibr-ready noise values.
why_it_matters: Historical reference for IMU noise characterisation.
hackathon_notes: Archived; prefer allan_variance_ros.

name: allan-variance (Python)
summary: Small Python package computing Allan variance and fitting standard noise parameters.
why_it_matters: Quick no-ROS Allan analysis in a notebook.
hackathon_notes: pip install; feed a numpy array of static IMU samples.

name: AV-Matlab-SW
summary: MATLAB software for Allan variance calculations accompanying a published article on IMU noise characterisation (Farrell et al.).
why_it_matters: Deeper treatment of Allan variance pitfalls than the typical tool.
hackathon_notes: Read with the paper; MATLAB required.

name: Kalibr
summary: ETH ASL calibration toolbox for multi-camera and camera-IMU systems (extrinsics and time offset), plus IMU intrinsics and rolling-shutter calibration.
why_it_matters: Standard way to calibrate a camera-IMU rig before running any VIO.
hackathon_notes: Use the Docker image to avoid ROS 1 build pain; print an AprilGrid target in advance.

name: iKalibr
summary: Continuous-time, targetless multi-sensor calibration framework (IMU, cameras, LiDAR, radar, RGB-D, event cameras) estimating extrinsics and time offsets (IEEE T-RO 2025).
why_it_matters: Calibrate a full heterogeneous rig, including radar, in one tool.
hackathon_notes: ROS-based with many dependencies; budget setup time.

name: imu_tk
summary: Tool for calibrating IMU intrinsics (misalignment, scale factors and biases of accelerometer and gyro) from a sequence of static poses, without a turntable.
why_it_matters: Cheap way to improve MEMS IMU accuracy before deploying a filter.
hackathon_notes: Needs Ceres; collect static poses in many orientations with short rotations between.

name: lidar_imu_calib
summary: Automatic calibration of the extrinsic rotation between a 3D LiDAR and an IMU.
why_it_matters: Quick LiDAR-IMU rotation estimate for LIO setups.
hackathon_notes: Inactive since 2021; rotation only.

name: LI-Calib
summary: Targetless LiDAR-IMU calibration based on continuous-time batch estimation (IROS 2020).
why_it_matters: Full LiDAR-IMU extrinsics without a target.
hackathon_notes: ROS 1; needs a sequence with rich excitation.

name: LiDAR_IMU_Init
summary: Real-time LiDAR-inertial initialization estimating extrinsics, time offset, gravity and IMU bias online (IROS 2022).
why_it_matters: Gets a LIO system calibrated in the field without a separate offline step.
hackathon_notes: Builds like FAST_LIO; feed a bag with aggressive motion at start.

name: AHRS (Python)
summary: Python collection of attitude estimation algorithms (Madgwick, Mahony, complementary, EKF, QUEST, TRIAD and more) plus utilities such as the World Magnetic Model and WGS84.
why_it_matters: One import to compare attitude filters on your IMU log.
hackathon_notes: pip install ahrs; numpy arrays in, quaternions out.

name: x-io Fusion
summary: x-io Technologies' C AHRS library (revised Madgwick-style algorithm) with gyro offset correction, acceleration and magnetic disturbance rejection, and Python bindings.
why_it_matters: Production-grade embedded attitude filter with disturbance rejection, from the Madgwick filter's originators.
hackathon_notes: Drop the C files into firmware or pip install imufusion for Python prototyping.

name: MadgwickAHRS (Arduino)
summary: Official Arduino library implementing the Madgwick AHRS filter.
why_it_matters: Fastest hardware demo of attitude estimation on a microcontroller.
hackathon_notes: Install from the Arduino library manager; set sample rate correctly.

name: madgwick_py
summary: Minimal Python implementation of Madgwick's IMU and AHRS algorithms.
why_it_matters: Readable algorithm reference.
hackathon_notes: Tiny, unmaintained; use for reading.

name: imu_tools
summary: ROS tools for IMUs: Madgwick and complementary orientation filters and an RViz IMU visualisation plugin.
why_it_matters: Standard ROS orientation filter feeding robot_localization.
hackathon_notes: apt install on ROS 2.

name: ZUPT-aided INS (OpenShoe MATLAB)
summary: MATLAB implementation of the OpenShoe zero-velocity-aided foot-mounted INS with several zero-velocity detectors (SHOE, acceleration variance and magnitude, angular rate energy).
why_it_matters: Reference for dismounted soldier / first responder navigation without GNSS.
hackathon_notes: Works with any foot-mounted IMU log; sample data included. No updates since 2021.

name: PyShoe
summary: Open Python foot-mounted INS from UTIAS with a public inertial dataset and several zero-velocity detectors, including learned ones.
why_it_matters: Ready-to-run dismounted navigation pipeline with data for evaluation.
hackathon_notes: Python; dataset download needed. Strap an IMU to a boot and compare detectors.

name: RoNIN
summary: Robust Neural Inertial Navigation: smartphone IMU dataset and baseline networks (ResNet, LSTM, TCN) regressing pedestrian velocity from IMU.
why_it_matters: Main benchmark and baselines for learned pedestrian inertial navigation.
hackathon_notes: PyTorch; dataset is large. Pretrained models give a quick baseline.

name: TLIO
summary: Tight Learned Inertial Odometry: a network regresses displacement and uncertainty from IMU windows, fused in a stochastic-cloning EKF.
why_it_matters: Strong blueprint for combining a learned motion prior with a classical filter.
hackathon_notes: Training data is head-mounted; expect domain gap on other platforms.

name: AI-IMU Dead-Reckoning
summary: Car dead reckoning from IMU only, using an invariant EKF whose noise covariances are adapted by a neural network, evaluated on KITTI.
why_it_matters: Ground vehicle navigation through GNSS outages using only the IMU.
hackathon_notes: PyTorch; KITTI raw data needed. Clear demo of IMU-only drift reduction.

name: Denoise IMU Gyro
summary: CNN that denoises low-cost gyroscope signals to improve attitude estimation.
why_it_matters: Shows learned correction for cheap MEMS gyros.
hackathon_notes: Inactive since 2020; trained on EuRoC/TUM-VI.

name: AirIMU
summary: Learns IMU error correction and uncertainty with a network, combined with differentiable IMU preintegration (CMU AirLab).
why_it_matters: Learned IMU correction that feeds uncertainty into classical estimators.
hackathon_notes: PyTorch and PyPose; pretrained models available.

name: AirIO
summary: Learning-based inertial odometry for UAVs that improves feature observability by changing the IMU data representation (IEEE RA-L 2025).
why_it_matters: Recent IMU-only drone odometry for GNSS-denied flight.
hackathon_notes: Recent research code; check README for datasets.

name: EqNIO
summary: Subequivariant neural inertial odometry (ICLR 2025) that canonicalises IMU data so networks generalise across orientations; applied on top of TLIO and RoNIN.
why_it_matters: State of the art learned inertial odometry with released code.
hackathon_notes: Builds on TLIO/RoNIN pipelines; set those up first.

name: Learned Inertial Odometry for Drone Racing
summary: UZH RPG code fusing a learned inertial displacement model with an EKF for drone racing state estimation.
why_it_matters: Shows learned IO on aggressive UAV flight.
hackathon_notes: Research code; datasets from UZH.

name: manif
summary: Header-only C++11 library for Lie theory (SO2, SE2, SO3, SE3, SE_2(3) and more) with Jacobians, built around Sola's micro Lie theory paper; Python bindings available.
why_it_matters: Correct on-manifold Jacobians for custom ESKF or factor-graph code.
hackathon_notes: Header-only C++; Python bindings (manifpy) via conda install -c conda-forge manifpy or pip install from a clone - there is no PyPI package. Use alongside the micro Lie theory paper.

name: Sophus
summary: C++ Lie group library (SO2, SE2, SO3, SE3, Sim3) built on Eigen, used in many SLAM and VIO systems.
why_it_matters: De facto Lie group dependency in SLAM codebases.
hackathon_notes: Header-mostly; widely packaged.

name: liegroups (Python)
summary: Python implementation of SO2, SE2, SO3 and SE3 matrix Lie groups with numpy and PyTorch backends.
why_it_matters: Lie group operations inside PyTorch for learned estimators.
hackathon_notes: pip install from source; small and stable.

name: navlie
summary: Python state estimation package on Lie groups (McGill DECAR): EKF, iterated EKF, sigma-point filters, batch estimation, and IMU kinematics models.
why_it_matters: Fastest way to prototype on-manifold INS filters in Python.
hackathon_notes: pip install; has IMU and GNSS-like examples.
